user.title: Maytronics Dolphin (BLE)
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address or the 12-character Dolphin advertised name, for example A1B2C3D4E5F6.

error.invalid_mac: Invalid value. Use AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF or 12 hexadecimal characters.

init.title: Maytronics Dolphin options
init.description: By default, Home Assistant connects only for one read or command, then disconnects. For faster response with a good Bluetooth proxy, set the state interval to 10 or 15 seconds. Persistent session is experimental and may wedge some robots.

data_description.ble_keepalive_seconds: Disconnects the BLE link if it stays open. 120 s is a good safety value.
data_description.state_poll_seconds: PS_State read frequency. 10 to 20 s is recommended with a nearby proxy. 0 disables automatic reads.
data_description.reconnect_button_enabled: Adds a button to force Bluetooth release.
data_description.diagnostic_probe_enabled: Adds extra GATT reads during updates. Keep disabled unless debugging.
data_description.ble_persistent_session_enabled: Keeps the GATT connection open between commands. Faster, but may wedge some robots.
